Delete method panics with empty string key

#### Description

The `Delete` method panics when called with an empty string key due to a slice bounds out of range error.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/allegro/bigcache/v3"
    "time"
)

func main() {
    cache, _ := bigcache.NewBigCache(bigcache.DefaultConfig(10 * time.Minute))
    
    // This will panic
    err := cache.Delete("")
    fmt.Println("Error:", err)
}
```

#### Expected behavior

The method should handle empty keys gracefully, either by returning an error or treating it as a no-op.

#### Actual behavior

```
panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range [:1] with length 0
```

The panic occurs when trying to slice an empty string with `key[:len(key)/2+1]` where `len(key)` is 0, making the slice operation `key[:1]` invalid on an empty string.

// newDefaultHasher returns a new 64-bit FNV-1a Hasher which makes no memory allocations.
// Its Sum64 method will lay the value out in big-endian byte order.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fowler–Noll–Vo_hash_function

	prime64 = 1099511628211

// Sum64 gets the string and returns its uint64 hash value.
func (f fnv64a) Sum64(key string) uint64 {
	var hash uint64 = offset64
	for i := 0; i < len(key); i++ {
		hash ^= uint64(key[i])

const (
	timestampSizeInBytes = 8                                                       // Number of bytes used for timestamp
	hashSizeInBytes      = 8                                                       // Number of bytes used for hash

	headersSizeInBytes   = timestampSizeInBytes + hashSizeInBytes + keySizeInBytes // Number of bytes used for all headers

func wrapEntry(timestamp uint64, hash uint64, key string, entry []byte, buffer *[]byte) []byte {
	keyLength := len(key)
	blobLength := len(entry) + headersSizeInBytes + keyLength

	if blobLength > len(*buffer) {
		*buffer = make([]byte, blobLength)
	}
	blob := *buffer

	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(blob, timestamp)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(blob[timestampSizeInBytes:], hash)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(blob[timestampSizeInBytes+hashSizeInBytes:], uint16(keyLength))
	copy(blob[headersSizeInBytes:], key)
	copy(blob[headersSizeInBytes+keyLength:], entry)

	return blob[:blobLength]
}

func appendToWrappedEntry(timestamp uint64, wrappedEntry []byte, entry []byte, buffer *[]byte) []byte {
	blobLength := len(wrappedEntry) + len(entry)
	if blobLength > len(*buffer) {

	}

	blob := *buffer

	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(blob, timestamp)
	copy(blob[timestampSizeInBytes:], wrappedEntry[timestampSizeInBytes:])
	copy(blob[len(wrappedEntry):], entry)

	return blob[:blobLength]
}

	length := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[timestampSizeInBytes+hashSizeInBytes:])

	copy(dst, data[headersSizeInBytes+length:])

	dst := make([]byte, length)
	copy(dst, data[headersSizeInBytes:headersSizeInBytes+length])

	return bytesToString(dst)
